coursesSection.title: Our Trainings
coursesSection.subtitle: Excellence-focused programs designed for the global stage.

flightAttendant.title: Flight Attendant (Cabin Crew)
flightAttendant.shortDesc: Reach for the sky with our elite cabin crew training.
flightAttendant.fullDesc: This comprehensive training prepares you for an exciting career in commercial aviation. You will learn everything from passenger safety and emergency procedures to exceptional customer service. Our state-of-the-art cabin simulators and experienced instructors ensure you are fully prepared for the demands of leading airlines.
flightAttendant.target: Aspiring cabin crew members with excellent communication skills, a service-oriented mindset, and high adaptability.
flightAttendant.prerequisites: High school diploma or equivalent, excellent English proficiency (other languages are a plus), good physical condition.
flightAttendant.outcomes: Flight Attendant / Cabin Crew for national and international airlines.

luxuryRestaurant.title: Luxury Restaurant Service Staff
luxuryRestaurant.shortDesc: Master the art of fine dining service.
luxuryRestaurant.fullDesc: Become an ambassador of culinary excellence. This program teaches you the subtleties of table service in Michelin-starred restaurants and luxury hotels. You will learn service techniques, sommelier skills, the art of table setting, and how to manage relationships with a demanding clientele.
luxuryRestaurant.target: Enthusiasts of gastronomy and service, wishing to work in prestigious establishments.
luxuryRestaurant.prerequisites: No formal prerequisites, but initial experience in the restaurant industry is appreciated. Strong motivation and impeccable presentation are essential.
luxuryRestaurant.outcomes: Maître d'hôtel, Head Waiter, Junior Sommelier in gastronomic restaurants, luxury hotels.

luxuryHotel.title: Luxury Hotel Service Staff
luxuryHotel.shortDesc: Excel in the world of high-end hospitality.
luxuryHotel.fullDesc: This training opens the doors to the world's greatest hotels. You will develop skills in reception, concierge services, room service, and customer relations, with an emphasis on personalizing the experience and anticipating the needs of an international clientele.
luxuryHotel.target: Candidates with excellent interpersonal skills, a polished appearance, and a passion for luxury hospitality.
luxuryHotel.prerequisites: High school diploma, fluency in English and another foreign language. Experience in hospitality is an advantage.
luxuryHotel.outcomes: Receptionist, Concierge, Housekeeper in 5-star hotels and palaces.

sommelier.title: Sommelier
sommelier.shortDesc: Become an expert in the world of wine.
sommelier.fullDesc: Travel through the world's vineyards without leaving our tasting room. Our sommelier training covers oenology, tasting, cellar management, food and wine pairing, and service. You will learn from renowned sommeliers and have the opportunity to visit prestigious wine estates.
sommelier.target: Wine lovers wishing to professionalize their passion, restaurant professionals.
sommelier.prerequisites: Good basic knowledge of wine. Experience in the restaurant industry is a plus.
sommelier.outcomes: Restaurant Sommelier, Wine Merchant, Wine Advisor, Representative for a winery.

fashionModel.title: Fashion Model
fashionModel.shortDesc: Walk the world's most prestigious runways.
fashionModel.fullDesc: This intensive program prepares you for the demanding world of modeling. It covers runway walking, photographic posing techniques, portfolio development, image and career management, as well as nutrition and wellness.
fashionModel.target: Young talents (men and women) with strong physical potential and a charismatic personality.
fashionModel.prerequisites: Industry-standard height and measurement criteria. Evaluation based on portfolio and interview.
fashionModel.outcomes: Runway model, advertising campaigns, fashion editorials.

footballCoach.title: Football Coach
footballCoach.shortDesc: Lead your team to victory with expert coaching skills.
footballCoach.fullDesc: Acquire the tactical, technical, and managerial skills to become a successful football coach. The program covers training session planning, match analysis, physical preparation, sports psychology, and team management.
footballCoach.target: Former players, sports educators, football enthusiasts aspiring to a coaching career.
footballCoach.prerequisites: Experience as a player or sports supervisor. Good knowledge of football.
footballCoach.outcomes: Coach for amateur or semi-professional clubs, youth coach, video analyst.

fifaAgent.title: FIFA Agent
fifaAgent.shortDesc: Navigate the world of professional football transfers.
fifaAgent.fullDesc: Become a key player in world football. This specialized training prepares you for the FIFA agent exam and teaches you sports law, contract negotiation, talent scouting, and the career management of professional players.
fifaAgent.target: Legal, marketing, or finance professionals with a passion for football. Former players in career transition.
fifaAgent.prerequisites: University degree (Law, Economics, Sports Management is a plus). In-depth knowledge of the football environment.
fifaAgent.outcomes: Licensed FIFA players' agent, collaborator in a sports agency, legal manager in a club.

sportsData.title: Sports Data Analyst
sportsData.shortDesc: Turn game data into winning strategies.
sportsData.fullDesc: Modern sport is driven by data. Learn to collect, analyze, and interpret performance data to optimize team strategies, player recruitment, and injury prevention. The program covers statistical tools, video analysis software, and data visualization.
sportsData.target: Analytical profiles with an interest in sports, students in sports science, mathematics, or computer science.
sportsData.prerequisites: 2/3 years of higher education. Strong logical and analytical skills. Knowledge of a programming language (Python, R) is a plus.
sportsData.outcomes: Data analyst for a professional club, a sports federation, or a sports media company.

fle.title: FLE (French as a Foreign Language)
fle.shortDesc: Immerse yourself in the French language and culture.
fle.fullDesc: Our French as a Foreign Language courses are designed for total immersion. Focused on communication, they will quickly provide you with the necessary skills to live, study, or work in France. We offer all levels, from complete beginner (A1) to expert (C2).
fle.target: International students, expatriates, professionals, and anyone wishing to learn French.
fle.outcomes: Mastery of French for personal, academic, or professional goals. Preparation for DELF/DALF exams.

hsk.title: HSK - Chinese Proficiency Test
hsk.fullDesc: Effectively prepare for the official Chinese proficiency test (HSK). Our courses specifically target the skills required for each level of the exam, from HSK 1 to HSK 6, by working on vocabulary, grammar, listening, and reading comprehension.
hsk.target: Students of Chinese, professionals working with China, anyone wishing for official certification of their level.
hsk.prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Chinese (depending on the target level).
hsk.outcomes: Success in the HSK exam, international recognition of Chinese language level.

tefl.title: TEFL - Teach English Abroad
tefl.shortDesc: Get certified to teach English anywhere in the world.
tefl.fullDesc: The TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) certificate is your passport to an international English teaching career. Our accredited program will give you the pedagogical tools, classroom management techniques, and confidence needed to effectively teach non-native speakers.
tefl.target: Native or bilingual English speakers wishing to travel and teach.
tefl.prerequisites: Excellent level of English. University degree recommended but not required.
tefl.outcomes: Globally recognized TEFL certification, access to our network of partner schools for job offers.

businessChina.title: Business & Digital Edge in China
businessChina.shortDesc: Understand and conquer the Chinese market.
businessChina.fullDesc: This program is essential for any professional targeting the Chinese market. It covers the cultural specifics of business in China, market entry strategies, the digital ecosystem (WeChat, Alibaba), cross-border e-commerce, and legal and financial aspects.
businessChina.target: Business leaders, marketing directors, export managers, entrepreneurs.
businessChina.prerequisites: Professional experience in business or marketing. No knowledge of Chinese is required.
businessChina.outcomes: Ability to develop and implement a development strategy for the Chinese market.

gatewayEurope.title: Gateway to Europe & Southeast Asia
gatewayEurope.fullDesc: Aimed at Asian entrepreneurs and companies, this program provides the keys to successfully establishing a presence in Europe. It covers European regulatory frameworks, intercultural marketing strategies, logistics, and the specifics of the main European markets.
gatewayEurope.target: Entrepreneurs and managers from Asia wishing to expand into Europe.
gatewayEurope.prerequisites: Solid business project. Good level of English or Chinese.
gatewayEurope.outcomes: Business plan for European expansion, network of contacts in Europe.

fifaAgentAlt.title: Sports Management
fifaAgentAlt.shortDesc: A comprehensive look into the business of sports.
fifaAgentAlt.fullDesc: This course offers a 360° perspective on the sports industry. Topics covered include sports marketing, sponsorship, event management, sports law, club and federation finance, and sports infrastructure management.
fifaAgentAlt.target: Students and professionals seeking a career in sports administration and management.
fifaAgentAlt.prerequisites: 2/3 years of higher education. Strong interest in sports and its economy.
fifaAgentAlt.outcomes: Positions in marketing, communication, event management, or administration within sports organizations.

aboutSection.title: A Bridge Between Europe & Asia
aboutSection.subtitle: Our Philosophy
aboutSection.paragraph1: PERPECTIVE PRO FORMATION was founded on a simple yet powerful idea: to create a multicultural educational environment that builds bridges between Europe and Asia. We believe that the future belongs to those who can navigate different cultures with ease and professionalism.
aboutSection.paragraph2: Our training programs, focused on high-growth sectors like luxury, sports, and international business, are designed to provide our students with not just theoretical knowledge, but also the practical skills and global mindset needed to succeed. We are more than a school; we are a launchpad for international careers.

testimonialsSection.title: From Our Alumni
testimonialsSection.subtitle: Success stories from around the globe.

1.quote: The Flight Attendant program was intense but incredibly rewarding. I landed my dream job with a major international airline just a month after graduating. The multicultural environment at the academy was the perfect preparation.
1.author: Chloé Dubois

2.quote: As a student from China, learning about European luxury standards was eye-opening. The teachers are industry experts, and the connections I made are invaluable. I now manage a boutique in Paris.
2.author: Wei Zhang (张伟)

3.quote: Transitioning from a finance career to becoming a FIFA Agent seemed impossible. This program gave me the structure, knowledge, and network to make it happen. A true game-changer.
3.author: Alexandre Martin

locations.sectionSubtitle: Unique learning environments in the heart of iconic French regions.
locations.pageSubtitle: Three exceptional locations for a complete immersion.

details.evron: Located in the charming town of Évron in Mayenne, our campus offers a peaceful and studious setting. Students benefit from modern facilities within a close-knit community, ideal for focusing on studies while discovering the French way of life.
details.sainteTulle: Nestled in the heart of Provence, the Sainte-Tulle campus is a true haven of peace. Surrounded by beautiful landscapes, it inspires creativity and well-being. It is the perfect place for our courses related to the art of living and hospitality.
details.sainteBazeille: Near Bordeaux, our Sainte-Bazeille campus is in the heart of one of the world's most famous wine regions. It offers a unique immersion for courses related to wine, gastronomy, and international management.
